column7: Reads local account names, enabled state and password requirement flags. Does not read passwords.

column7: Reports local adapter configuration with ipconfig /all.

column7: Reads the local routing table without adding or deleting routes.

column7: Reads Windows Time source and last synchronization state.

column7: Runs gpupdate /target:computer /force. Reapplies local/organizational policy without automatic logoff or reboot.

column7: Reads update services and local WSUS and automatic-update policy indicators.
